game.title: LOOP GAIDEN GAME
game.body: A 2D fight game planned for the future where Loop clears Bundles, Goons, and Snipers before facing the Greed Lords behind the trenches.

manifesto.title: THE TRENCHES
paragraphs: Meme coins were supposed to belong to the people. Somewhere along the way, value stopped circulating and started flowing in one direction.
Loop Gaiden is a story about what meme coin culture became — farmers, extractors, manipulators, bundles, bots, snipers and the people caught in between.
statements: THE TRENCHES DECIDE WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

mission.title: FROM THE TRENCHES TO THE SEVEN GREED LORDS
mission.body: A living path through the Loop Gaiden universe. Each issue reveals the next threat.
